title: Weekly micro-goals & manager prep — personal ops scratchpad
content:
Purpose: quick, lightweight notebook for the week — capture wins, micro-goals, manager talking points, and example evidence for formal reviews. Not polished. Use before 1:1s and when filling out review forms.

---

This week focus (top 3):
- Close onboarding checklist for DS hires (deadline Tue) — items left: laptop enrollment (IT ticket), buddy pairing meeting invite.
- Two micro-sprints on interview calibration: write 3 sample behavioral prompts and run short calibration with 2 hiring managers.
- Prep evidence for quarterly review: pick 2 cross-team projects and summarize impact in one sentence each.

Quick wins (recent, to stash as review evidence):
- Reduced average time-to-offer by ~2 days after streamlining offer letter template (HR-1423).
- Ran triage on attrition drivers with Eng lead; surfaced 3 low-effort retention levers (flex stipend clarification, manager training slot, improved exit survey follow-ups).

Anecdotes / stories that show impact (short bullets):
- When hiring manager X expressed concern about interview variance, I organized a 30-min calibration that resulted in a shared rubric and eliminated one inconsistent question across panel. Outcome: panel confidence +1.
- Worked with Ops to automate laptop provisioning; first 3 hires from the new flow had zero setup blockers on day 1.

Evidence mapping (for review):
- Competency: Hiring & Talent Ops — Evidence: revamped offer template + metrics (time-to-offer -2d).
- Competency: Partnering — Evidence: calibration session + follow-up rubric (shared doc + manager quotes).
- Competency: Execution — Evidence: onboarding checklist closed (link to checklist in HR ticket).

Manager 1:1 talking points (10–12 min top-of-call):
- Quick status on onboarding items (ask: approval for one-time stipend for relocation questions).
- Two asks: 1) budget approval for one extra contractor for calibration work (3 weeks) 2) explicit priority on adding interviewers to panel for the PM role.
- Flag: capacity risk if more than 3 concurrent senior roles open next month (need headcount reprioritization).
- Request feedback: where do you want me to focus less/more next quarter?

Phrasing for the review form (short snippets I can copy):
- "Led initiative to reduce time-to-offer by simplifying offer documentation and automating approvals; result: average process time decreased by ~2 days and candidate acceptance velocity improved."
- "Coordinated cross-functional interview calibration to improve scoring consistency; produced a reusable rubric adopted by 4 teams."

Open questions / uncertainties:
- Do we count time-to-offer improvement as a people ops metric or a recruiting metric for my review? (ask manager)
- Should I list the calibration rubric under 'process innovation' or 'partnering' in the competency mapping?

Micro-goals checklist (daily small items):
- [ ] Send calendar invites for onboarding buddies (Mon)
- [ ] Draft 3 behavioral prompts and share with PM hiring managers (Wed)
- [ ] Pull time-to-offer numbers for last 3 months (Thu)
- [ ] Write one-paragraph impact statements for two projects (Fri)

Habits to keep building (behavioral):
- Block 90 minutes of heads-down time M/W/F to actually write review artifacts.
- Keep 1:1 agenda to <=12 items; prioritize decisions at top.

Risk register (short):
- Risk: multiple senior hires overlap -> impact: slows calibration and interview bandwidth. Mitigation: propose short-term contractor + prioritize roles.
- Risk: no clear owner for offer approvals -> offer delays. Mitigation: escalate to HR ops and add automation step.

Notes to self (scrappy):
- Save quotes from hiring managers after calibration (slack thread).
- Capture before/after metrics in one spreadsheet — include baseline numbers.
- If manager asks who else should be involved -> suggest Eng hiring lead + recruiter + one senior IC for each panel.

Next steps (this doc):
1) Complete onboarding checklist by Tue EOD and move to 'done' column.
2) Run calibration dry-run with 2 managers before Thurs.
3) Draft review evidence paragraph and send to Maya for quick proofread by Fri.

Random brain dump (usually messy):
- Idea: micro-badges for managers who complete interview training (small public recognition in all-hands).
- Thought: maybe add a short 'candidate experience' pulse survey at day 3 of onboarding. Could surface friction early.

---

End of scratchpad. Keep concise; prune before copy to official review doc.
